units.source_text: 是年十二月，冷泉帝行幸大原野。

en.t: In December of that year, Emperor Reizei made an imperial visit to Oharano.
The whole world seemed stirred up, and everyone poured out into the streets.

units.source_text: 六条院的女眷也都出来观光。

en.t: The women of the Rokujo estate also all came out to watch the spectacle.

units.source_text: 御驾于卯时出宫，由朱雀门经五条大街，折而向西。

en.t: The imperial carriage left the palace at the hour of the hare, passed through the Suzaku Gate and along Fifth Avenue, then turned west.

units.source_text: 道旁游览车接踵，直到桂川岸边，稠密无有空隙。

en.t: Sightseeing carriages lined the roadside one after another, packed without a gap all the way to the bank of the Katsura River.

units.source_text: 天皇行幸，并不一定铺张，但此次规模异常盛大：

en.t: Imperial outings were not always lavish, but this one was on an unusually grand scale:

units.source_text: 诸亲王、诸公卿都特别用心，把马匹和鞍子整饰得十分漂亮。

en.t: The princes and high nobles all took special care, decorating the horses and saddles with great beauty.

units.source_text: 随从和马副都选用容貌端正、身材等高的人，给他们穿上美丽的衣服。

en.t: For the attendants and grooms, they chose people with handsome faces and matching heights, and dressed them in beautiful clothes.

units.source_text: 因此气象壮丽，迥异寻常。

en.t: As a result, the scene was magnificent and utterly different from the ordinary.

units.source_text: 左右大臣、内大臣，以及纳言以下诸臣，当然全体随驾。

en.t: The Ministers of the Left and Right, the Inner Minister, and all the officials from the counselors downward naturally accompanied the imperial procession.

units.source_text: 自殿上人以至五位、六位的官员，一律许穿尘色官袍及淡紫色衬袍。

en.t: From the courtiers of the palace down to officials of the fifth and sixth ranks, all were permitted to wear dust-colored court robes and pale purple under-robes.
